_doc: Linux systems the DayZero builder can put on a USB stick (builder/lib/Linux.psm1).
baseUrl:     official HTTPS download folder. Only hosts in allowedHosts are accepted (tests check this).
sums:        checksum file in that folder (sha256sum format). The ISO must match it, byte for byte.
isoPattern:  regex for the ISO name inside the checksum file; the newest point release wins.
automation:  'ubuntu-autoinstall' = DayZero writes autoinstall.yaml + the Linux kit (kit/linux).
The disk screen ALWAYS stays interactive: DayZero never picks, wipes or partitions a disk.
largestFile: biggest single file seen in the ISO (bytes). FAT32 holds files up to 4 GB - 1 byte;
the builder checks the real files again before it erases anything.
Any other Linux ISO can still be written as-is ('raw' write) with no DayZero automation.
